The '''''One Liner''''', formerly the '''''Flat Liner''''', was originally a stock [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] purchased by [[Erlick Frodar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After being heavily used for spare parts for other vessels, the ''One Liner'' was sent on one last mission to assist in the evacuation of [[Jatee]], where it was destroyed.

==Description==
The ''One Liner'' was originally a YT-1300, but after being used for spare parts it was barely functional by the time of the evacuation of [[Jatee]]. By the time of its destruction almost all its primary systems had been taken out and replaced with either backups, or cheaper models. Its [[Life support/Legends|life support]] was on backup only, its [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]] were damaged, and its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was a poorer substitute for the stock YT-1300 model. "''The One Liner''" was painted unceremoniously on its hull by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]].<ref name="EJ" />

==History==
The ''Flat Liner'' was purchased by [[Erlick Frodar]] after his discharge from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Erlick intended to become a freighter captain in his home [[Demophon sector/Legends|Demophon sector]]. Unfortunately he could not compete with the legal interests there, and after going bankrupt he and the ''Flat Liner'' turned to smuggling. The ''Flat Liner'' was regularly used to ferry rebel agents, posing as mercenaries, to their destination, and was involved in many dogfights with the Imperial Navy. When Erlick was recruited by the Alliance, the ''Flat Liner'' went with him. It remained in service until Erlick accepted a position as commander of [[Asteroid Base]]. Since Erlick was no longer a space captain, the ''Flat Liner'' was first reserved for evacuation, and then with Erlick's permission used for spare parts. It was during this time that it was rechristened the ''One Liner'' by rebel technicians. Its final mission was ferrying rebel agents to [[Jatee]] to help evacuate the [[Ssither]] to the [[Demophon (star)|Demophon]] [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. After its arrival it was destroyed to prevent any [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attention.<ref name="EJ" />
